(Search snippet content — Al Jazeera's own reporting language)
Iran has not publicly commented on the letter, but was reported to have "received well" Vance's message. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi spoke of ongoing negotiations in a social media post, saying Iran "continues to give diplomacy a chance".
United States Vice President JD Vance sent a letter to Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, in an 11th-hour push to restart peace talks. The letter and follow-up discussions did not cover specific peace terms, but rather a potential "framework for negotiations".
